question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "about."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this context, **"about"** is used to convey the idea that the individuals or things being observed are engaged in their usual activities or daily routines.</li&
